name: polymarket-three-api-backends
description: Polymarket API uses three distinct backends: Data API (data-api.polymarket.com) for leaderboard, positions (/v1/positions), and activity; Gamma API (gamma-api.polymarket.com) for market metadata; CLOB API (clob.polymarket.com) for fill prices and midpoints. Positions moved from CLOB /positions to Data /v1/positions in v2 spec.
